deliverables.name: One consolidated correctness/platform/migration/install regression
deliverables.current: The 18-case dependency-bound acceptance, 32 common CLI scenarios and 15 actual desktop cases passed. Unchanged core/runtime/GUI and MSI recipes retain their original exact-byte or contract evidence. Final Windows installer-only exceptions are explicitly bound: TLS child handles are released before directory rename, and inherited configuration ACEs become explicit rules before write filtering. Fresh machine TLS preparation/idempotence/17 pinned files and protected ACLs passed; 44 updater checks and 57 real configuration migration/recovery entries passed, followed by actual final machine takeover.
deliverables.remaining: No remaining failure in the declared platform scope. Windows ARM64 and macOS runtime boundaries remain explicit.

deliverables.name: One final paired latency/performance batch
deliverables.current: The current exact-artifact 10-pair local/HTTPS batch passes all five items in 596.63 seconds, with complete output checks at 1k/10k/100k files. Previous 40/20-pair reports retain their original hashes. Current HTTPS clone and large full scans remain slower than the desired low-latency ideal; no universal advantage is claimed.
